newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle not fully established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle not fully established - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not fully established early Wednesday on a dressed basis delivered, paid on hot carcass weights, USDA said. Trade was rather slow.
Dressed basis steers: Few select and choice 2-3 1225-1275 lbs 115.00. Dressed basis heifers: few select and choice 2-3 1125-1150 115.00.
There were no sales reported on slaughter steers or heifers on a live basis. Confirmed: 500 For the week: 4,900.
